description.value:
Trigger A foe hits you with a melee weapon or unarmed attack that deals physical damage.

You relax yourself the instant you are hit to minimize the damage it deals to your body. You fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone] and are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1}. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:6]. On a success, you take minimum damage from the attack, and on a critical success, if the attack was a critical hit, you don't take double damage.
